formula: Subject + base verb + object   |   Negative: Subject + don't + base verb
when_to_use: Use the present simple for daily routines, habits and things that are always true.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للروتين اليومي والعادات والحقائق الدائمة.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Arabic conjugates the verb itself for every person, so learners look for an ending on English verbs too. With I/you/we/they the English verb takes NO ending at all.

common_errors.explanation: Do not add 'am' before a normal verb.

quick_rule: I/you/we/they + base verb (no ending). Negative = don't + base verb.
quick_rule_ar: I/you/we/they مع الفعل المجرد بدون إضافة. والنفي بـ don't + الفعل.
mnemonic: No -s for I, YOU, WE, THEY.
connect_to_speaking: Describe your day: 'I get up at seven, I eat breakfast and I go to work. I don't watch TV in the morning.'
